exposure: cesarean delivery on maternal request without any medical indications (CDMR)
outcome: DNA methylation status in umbilical cord blood
cohort: 70 newborns delivered by CDMR and 70 newborns delivered vaginally in Shanghai, China in 2012
finding: While initial analysis showed differences in DNA methylation at 165 sites between CDMR and VD groups, these differences were largely explained by cell type proportions after adjustment.
mod_finding: Infants born by cesarean delivery on maternal request (CDMR) initially showed differences in DNA methylation at 165 sites compared to those born vaginally, but this was attributed to cell type proportions upon further analysis.
